items.title: Strategy Rockets 13%, Bitmine Immersion Technologies Rallies 13%, Coinbase Jumps 11% as Bitcoin Surges Past $68,000
items.summary: Bitcoin just broke above $68,000 for the first time in months, sparking a furious single-day surge across crypto equities, but the companies leading the charge are still nursing brutal year-to-date losses that raise the question of whether this rally signals a real turning point or just a violent short squeeze.

items.title: Ken Fisher’s Firm Seen Behind $4 Billion Contrarian Bond Trade
items.summary: Billionaire Ken Fisher’s eponymous firm appears to be betting that the longest-dated US bonds will rally, a contrarian stance that seeks to capitalize on yields close to their highest in two decades.
